current_boundary: Paper12 supports local weak-supervision adaptation evidence, not a validated ArcGIS replacement claim.

decision_rule.not_validated: Use when independent manual ground truth, ArcGIS reference output, or Paper12 checkpoint-backed output is missing.
decision_rule.partial: Use when all paired outputs exist but Paper12 does not meet the replacement threshold on at least one primary metric or critical class.
decision_rule.replacement_candidate: Use only when Paper12 matches or exceeds the ArcGIS reference on the same manual labels, area, time window, and taxonomy.

next_actions: Sample and manually annotate Linhe validation patches or polygons using the highest-resolution imagery available.
Export ArcGIS or Esri reference predictions for the same samples and class taxonomy.
Run the Paper12 checkpoint-backed Houlsby workflow on the same samples.
Report per-class IoU, overall accuracy, macro F1, and confusion matrices for both systems against the same manual labels.
Run scripts/evaluate_arcgis_replacement.py on the completed manual, ArcGIS, and Paper12 manifest before changing decision_status.
